username = ""

status_texts.action: Go back and try again. If you followed a link, it may have been cut short when it was copied.
status_texts.meaning: The address or the information sent with it was not in a form the server accepts.
status_texts.title: The request could not be understood

status_texts.action: Sign in, then open the link again.
status_texts.meaning: This needs a signed-in account, and you are not signed in or your session has ended.
status_texts.title: You need to sign in

status_texts.action: If you think you should have access, ask the owner of the project or space, or an administrator, to add you.
status_texts.meaning: You are signed in, but your account is not allowed to see or do this.
status_texts.title: You do not have access to this

status_texts.action: Check the address, use search, or ask the person who sent you the link.
status_texts.meaning: Nothing is at this address for your account. It may have been moved, archived or deleted, or it may be in a project or space you are not a member of.
status_texts.title: This does not exist, or you cannot see it

status_texts.action: Go back and use the buttons and links in the application.
status_texts.meaning: The address exists but does not support what was asked of it.
status_texts.title: That is not possible at this address

status_texts.action: Check your connection and try again.
status_texts.meaning: The server stopped waiting because the request did not arrive in time, usually because of a slow or interrupted connection.
status_texts.title: The request took too long to arrive

status_texts.action: Reload to see the current state, then make your change again.
status_texts.meaning: Someone else changed the same thing first, or the change conflicts with something that already exists.
status_texts.title: This changed while you were working on it

status_texts.action: Ask the person who sent you the link whether there is a replacement.
status_texts.meaning: It existed once and has been removed for good.
status_texts.title: This is no longer available

status_texts.action: Send a smaller file, or split it. An administrator can tell you the limit.
status_texts.meaning: The file or the text you sent is larger than this installation accepts.
status_texts.title: That is too large

status_texts.action: Check the file type and try again.
status_texts.meaning: The server does not accept this type of file or data at this address.
status_texts.title: That kind of content is not accepted here

status_texts.action: Go back, correct the highlighted fields, and try again.
status_texts.meaning: The request was understood, but a value in it is missing or not allowed.
status_texts.title: Something in the request is not valid

status_texts.action: Wait a minute, then try again.
status_texts.meaning: Too much was asked of the server in a short time from your account or your network, so it is briefly refusing more.
status_texts.title: Too many requests

status_texts.action: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, tell support and include the reference below.
status_texts.meaning: The server ran into a problem it did not expect. It was recorded. Nothing you did caused it.
status_texts.title: Something went wrong on the server

status_texts.action: Ask an administrator whether it can be turned on.
status_texts.meaning: This installation does not have the feature this address needs.
status_texts.title: This is not set up

status_texts.action: Wait a minute and reload. If it lasts, tell support.
status_texts.meaning: The server in front of the application could not reach it. It may be restarting or being upgraded.
status_texts.title: The application is not answering

status_texts.action: Wait a few minutes and reload. If it lasts, tell support.
status_texts.meaning: The application is running but cannot serve requests right now, for example during maintenance or because the database is unreachable.
status_texts.title: Temporarily unavailable

status_texts.action: Try again. If you were asking for something large, narrow it down.
status_texts.meaning: The server in front of the application gave up waiting for an answer.
status_texts.title: The application took too long to answer
